goal: Is ke baad aap for loop aur cin se array mein values read kar sakte hain, saare elements display kar sakte hain, pehle size read kar sakte hain (ek maximum tak), aur array ko reverse mein print kar sakte hain.
warmup: Aap ki teacher 5 students ke marks ek ek karke announce karti hain. Aap unhein ek page par 5 boxes mein likhte hain: box 0, box 1, box 2, box 3, box 4. Baad mein woh kehti hain 'dobara parh kar sunao'. Aap pehle box se shuru karte hain aur box ba box aakhri tak jaate hain. C++ mein array bhi bilkul aise hi kaam karta hai. Ek loop boxes ko fill karta hai, doosra loop unhein parh kar sunata hai. Loop counter hi box ka number hota hai.
definition: Array same type ke boxes ki ek row hai. Har box ka ek number hota hai jise index kehte hain, aur pehla index 0 hota hai. Box i mein value read karne ke liye aap cin >> a[i] likhte hain. Usay show karne ke liye cout << a[i] likhte hain. Kyun ke boxes ke number 0, 1, 2 aur isi tarah chalte hain, counter i wala for loop natural tool hai: counter indexes se guzarta hai aur a[i] mojooda index ka box hai.
howItWorks: Trace ko step by step dekhein. Loop counter i 0 se shuru hota hai. Har dafa loop chalta hai, cin >> a[i] agla typed number box i mein daal deta hai, phir i 1 se barh jata hai. Jab i array ke size tak pohanch jata hai to condition i < size false ho jati hai aur loop ruk jata hai. Doosra loop wahi chakkar lagata hai, lekin cout ke saath. Do rules yaad rakhein: (1) valid indexes 0 se size - 1 tak hote hain, size kabhi nahi; (2) array ka size declare karte waqt pata hona chahiye, is liye jab user khud faisla kare ke kitni values enter karni hain, to aap pehle ek bara array declare karte hain (const int MAX = 100;), phir n read karte hain (kitni values), check karte hain ke n MAX se zyada na ho, aur loop sirf n tak chalate hain. Reverse mein print karne ke liye counter ko n - 1 se shuru karein aur 0 tak neeche count karein.
